stories.title: India Mandates Registered Caller Name Display on 4G and Newer Networks From November 1
stories.description: India orders telecom operators to show registered caller names for unsaved domestic numbers from November 1, 2026, under its CNAP rules.

stories.description: Ransomware gangs are moving beyond locked files and stolen data. Criminals now threaten employees, executives, and their families to force companies to pay.

stories.title: CenterPoint Energy Data Breach Impacts 1 Million Texans
